input_binding.raw: Exact official Map tile crops + recorded official municipal zone/population responses, hashes and requests
input_binding.native: Rasterio 1.4.3 / GDAL with nearest 10 m metric grid, GeoPandas zones, centre assignment, independent per-polygon count oracle
input_binding.mcp: Pinned original GDAL MCP / FastMCP 2.12.3 plus eight explicitly named municipal tools; 21 exposed
input_binding.method: Declared 2021 vegetation classes including cropland; land excludes water/NoData; strict cutoff 0.20 and sensitivity 0.40 on identical inputs
input_binding.population: 2025-12-31 aggregate zone population; missing stays null; municipal reconciliation preserved

scope: Only these observed statistical zones, historical classification, explicit methods/operations and parameters; not all Rasterio/GDAL, current canopy, access, thermal exposure or authoritative municipal advice.

municipal_case.question: Which administrative zones have low mapped 2021 vegetation share, and how much published 2025 aggregate population is attached to those zones?

agent_acceptance.codex: All 21 tools, full paged CSVs, actual analysis/comparison payloads, artifact hashes and JSON claims pass. passed_for_declared_brief
agent_acceptance.hermes: All 21 tools, full paged CSVs, actual analysis/comparison payloads, artifacts and JSON claims pass; broader narrative fails factual review.

admission_meaning: Reproducible computational workflow for declared data/method, separate from prose correctness, independent-person qualification and final-product promotion
